high.title: Latest Savings Interest Rate Table - June 3rd
high.summary: LPBank has cut interest rates across multiple terms but remains among market leaders. The bank reduced rates for 6-25 month terms by 0.05-0.2 percentage points. Specifically, 6-11 month deposits dropped 0.1pp to 6.8%/year, while 12-month rates fell to 6.9%/year, ending the 7%/year rate for 12-month online savings. The 24-25 month terms saw the largest cuts of 0.2pp to 7%/year, now LPBank's highest online deposit rate. Despite cuts, LPBank remains in the leading group for deposit rates, signaling continued competition among banks for funding. This rate adjustment reflects broader monetary policy trends and banks' funding needs, which could impact VND liquidity and bond market dynamics.

high.title: A Decade of Profit Leadership: Vietcombank, VietinBank and BIDV - What Creates the Banking Sector's Largest Profits?
high.summary: Over the past decade, Vietnam's Big 3 state-owned banks have maintained their dominance despite fierce competition from private banks. Vietcombank, VietinBank and BIDV sustained profits around VND7-8 trillion in 2015, growing to over VND43 trillion each by 2025 (BIDV reaching VND38 trillion). While their 10-year CAGR of 17-20% was lower than many private banks, their scale advantage and stable funding base kept them at the top. This analysis reveals the structural strength of state-owned banks in Vietnam's financial system, their ability to maintain market share, and their role as stability anchors. For bond investors, this highlights the continued creditworthiness of these institutions and their capacity to absorb government bonds.

high.title: SJC Gold and Ring Gold Prices Today (June 3rd): Continue to Decline
high.summary: Gold prices continued declining, falling VND500,000/tael across major brands. SJC gold bars now trade at VND154-157 million/tael, down from VND154.5-157.5 million earlier. Gold rings also dropped VND500,000/tael with SJC at VND153.8-156.8 million/tael. The continued decline follows a VND1 million/tael drop on June 2nd, representing significant volatility in Vietnam's gold market. This gold price movement often correlates with VND/USD dynamics and inflation expectations, making it relevant for FX traders monitoring domestic liquidity conditions and safe-haven demand patterns.

medium.title: Organizational Structure Changes at State Bank of Vietnam
medium.summary: Decree 198/2026/ND-CP restructures the State Bank of Vietnam without changing the number of units (20 units remain). Key changes include renaming the Economic Sector Credit Department to Credit Department, and the Forecasting, Statistics - Monetary and Financial Stability Department to Forecasting and Statistics Department. This administrative reorganization may streamline SBV operations and policy implementation.

medium.title: One Banking Stock Heavily Sold by Securities Firms' Proprietary Trading During Market Rally
medium.summary: VN-Index gained 12.54 points (+0.69%) to 1,831.55, breaking a 7-session decline. However, foreign investors sold a massive VND5,760 billion net across the market. Securities firms' proprietary trading sold VND369 billion net on HOSE, with ACB being the heaviest sold at -VND82 billion, followed by FPT, SSI, MBB, and VIB.

medium.title: Domestic Investors Pour Hundreds of Trillions into Vietnamese Stocks, Offsetting Foreign Selling Pressure
medium.summary: Domestic investors have net bought nearly VND70 trillion on HOSE since early 2026, and over VND280 trillion since early 2022. This strong domestic capital flow has become the main driver of Vietnam's stock market, offsetting persistent foreign selling. Foreign ownership has dropped to a record low of around 12%, while domestic investors now dominate market dynamics.

medium.title: "Shark" Worth VND15 Trillion Could Strongly Accumulate Shares of Billionaire Pham Nhat Vuong
medium.summary: VanEck Vietnam ETF is expected to restructure based on MarketVector Vietnam Local Index review. Yuanta Securities forecasts potential addition of VPL and MBS, while removing HDG and CTR. The portfolio changes will be finalized by June 19th, 2026, effective from June 22nd, creating notable supply-demand dynamics for affected stocks.
